Main subject only: 3–5 clean readable painted planes, a few broad confident brush edges, one localized accent light. Matte flat color, not polished digital rendering. Very low spatial frequency. Quiet surface interiors without texture. Dark futuristic-city mood, ink blue / charcoal / muted slate, single accent color. Left half calm dark negative space. Wide 16:9. Absolutely no people, text, signs, numbers, UI or logos. Do NOT add debris, brick grids, window grids, cables, scratches, rain streaks, intricate machinery, tiny reflections, impasto texture, speckling, crisp background architecture or countless painterly fragments.
